text: At the start of your next turn, enter Wrath and draw 2 cards.

name: Alchemize
text: Keywords: Exhaust. Obtain a random potion.

name: Vigilance
text: Gain 8 Block. Enter Calm.

name: Violence
text: Keywords: Exhaust. Put 3 random Attacks from your draw pile into your hand.

name: Void
text: Keywords: Unplayable, Ethereal. Whenever this card is drawn, lose 1 Energy.

name: Wallop
text: Deal 9 damage. Gain Block equal to unblocked damage dealt.

name: Warcry
text: Keywords: Exhaust. Draw 1 card. Put a card from your hand onto the top of your draw pile.

name: Wave of the Hand
text: Whenever you gain Block this turn, apply 1 Weak to ALL enemies.

name: Weave
text: Deal 4 damage. Whenever you Scry, return this from the discard pile to your Hand.

name: Well-Laid Plans
text: At the end of your turn, Retain up to 1 card.

name: Wheel Kick
text: Deal 15 damage. Draw 2 cards.

name: Whirlwind
text: Deal 5 damage to ALL enemies X times.

name: White Noise
text: Keywords: Exhaust. Add a random Power card into your hand. It costs 0 this turn.

name: Wild Strike
text: Deal 12 damage. Shuffle a Wound into your draw pile.

name: Windmill Strike
text: Keywords: Retain. Deal 7 damage. When Retained, increase its damage by 4 this combat.

name: Foresight
text: At the start of your turn, Scry 3.

name: Wish
text: Keywords: Exhaust. Choose one: Gain 6 Plated Armor, 3 Strength, or 25 Gold.

name: Worship
text: Gain 5 Mantra.

name: Wraith Form
text: Gain 2 Intangible. At the end of your turn, lose 1 Dexterity.

name: Wreath of Flame
text: Your next Attack deals 5 additional damage.

name: Zap
text: Channel 1 Lightning.

name: Akabeko
text: Your first Attack each combat deals 8 additional damage.

name: Anchor
text: Start each combat with 10 Block.

name: Ancient Tea Set
text: Whenever you enter a Rest Site, start the next combat with 2 energy.

name: Art of War
text: If you do not play any Attacks during your turn, gain an additional energy next turn.

name: Astrolabe
text: Upon pickup, Transform 3 cards, then Upgrade them.

name: Bag of Marbles
text: At the start of each combat, apply 1 Vulnerable to ALL enemies.

name: Bag of Preparation
text: At the start of each combat, draw 2 additional cards.

name: Bird-Faced Urn
text: Whenever you play a Power card, heal 2 HP.

name: Black Blood
text: Replaces Burning Blood. At the end of combat, heal 12 HP.

name: Black Star
text: Elites drop an additional relic when defeated.

name: Bloody Idol
text: Whenever you gain Gold, heal 5 HP.

name: Blood Vial
text: At the start of each combat, heal 2 HP.

name: Blue Candle
text: Unplayable Curse cards can now be played. Whenever you play a Curse, lose 1 HP and Exhaust it.

name: The Boot
text: Whenever you would deal 4 or less unblocked attack damage, increase it to 5.

name: Bottled Flame
text: Upon pickup, choose an Attack. Start each combat with this card in your hand.

name: Bottled Lightning
text: Upon pickup, choose a Skill. Start each combat with this card in your hand.

name: Bottled Tornado
text: Upon pickup, choose a Power card. Start each combat with this card in your hand.

name: Brimstone
text: At the start of your turn, gain 2 Strength and ALL enemies gain 1 Strength.

name: Bronze Scales
text: Start each combat with 3 Thorns.

name: Burning Blood
text: At the end of combat, heal 6 HP.

name: Busted Crown
text: Gain 1 energy at the start of your turn. Future card rewards have 2 less cards to choose from.

name: Gold-Plated Cables
text: Your rightmost Orb triggers its passive an additional time.

name: Calipers
text: At the start of your turn, lose 15 Block rather than all of your Block.

name: Calling Bell
text: Upon pickup, obtain a unique Curse and 3 relics.

name: Captain's Wheel
text: At the start of your 3rd turn, gain 18 Block.

name: Cauldron
text: Upon pickup, brews 5 random potions.

name: Centennial Puzzle
text: The first time you lose HP each combat, draw 3 cards.

name: Ceramic Fish
text: Whenever you add a card to your deck, gain 9 Gold.

name: Champion Belt
text: Whenever you apply Vulnerable, apply 1 Weak.
